crossRefs.note: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.
I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids;
Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in…
Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.
Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.
Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming, whether at evening, or at midnight, or when…
lest coming suddenly he might find you sleeping.

translations.web: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
